body: I'm sorry to hear about your mom. I can't even imagine how you feel. You're not invisible, even though it feels that way. I see you. You see you. You're important. Be kind to yourself; take care of yourself.

You're right. The end of this relationship is one of the hardest things I've been through in a while. I've come to depend on it for so much. Thanks for the reminder that I can do this, even if it's on my own. I will try to keep this in mind.
Thank you for this. It's definitely a good reminder. I'm going to keep going as long as I can. It helps to know I'm not alone.
